summary.intent: Renumber phases 71-73 in the CipherBox ROADMAP.md so phase numbers reflect actual execution order (share-invite API and SDK write-plane before web nav), since 71/72 must run after 70/73 conceptually but should be numbered in the order they execute.
summary.outcome: Reordered and renumbered the phase detail block (70 rotation → 71 share-invite API → 72 SDK write-plane → 73 web nav), fixed the cross-reference in the web phase's 'Depends on' field, corrected the summary bullets after an edit mismatch, verified renumbering consistency across the file, and committed the change.

repo: CipherBox's .planning/ROADMAP.md summary bullets and detail blocks must stay in sync when phases are renumbered — both need separate edits.
Phase detail blocks in ROADMAP.md include a 'Depends on' cross-reference field that must be updated when phase numbers change.
workflow: After editing markdown text, re-read the file before assuming the edit matched exactly — auto-formatting or subtle wording differences (e.g. 'direct bulk-revoke' vs 'bulk-revoke') can cause the intended replacement to silently mismatch.
When renumbering/reordering structured plan docs, do a final grep/verify pass for consistency before committing.

friction: An Edit produced unexpected formatting/wording changes, requiring a re-read and per-line correction instead of a single bulk edit.
